steps.name: Summary: slim top bar with the flags top right, five tabs at the bottom, all ten party cards in two columns
Party card: a tap highlights the party; the filters tab counts it; the House dims the others
Map: a full-screen map; a province opens with its constituencies above a panel; a constituency opens in the panel
Back button: constituency → province → map of Thailand → summary, instead of leaving the site
Colour key and colourings: the key opens over the map with the full credit; a sheet explains all five colourings
Search: its own tab and panel, a 16 px field (no zoom on iPhone), examples; a result opens on the map
Filters: a panel with region, province and party (16 px menus), the theme, the data status and Clear All
Analysis: one chart at a time; previous / next and a list of all seven charts with their questions
Analysis tap: the first tap opens the tooltip as a card above the tab bar; its button does what a click does
Analysis details: a constituency opens in a sheet that can be dragged down to close
Small phone 360×780 and 375×667: no sideways scrolling, panel and map share the screen
Held sideways (844×390): the tabs become a rail on the left and the map sits beside its details
Phones held sideways wider than 900 px (932×430) still get the phone layout; a desktop window of the same size does not
Desktop keeps its layout; resizing a window across 900 px switches layouts both ways
